title: Concept: Ruby or Rails stack frame disclosed in a response
description: A response discloses a Ruby stack frame. Production error pages should never carry interpreter backtraces: the file path maps the source tree, the method name maps internal call structure, and the gem paths disclose exact dependency versions that can be matched against known issues.
applicability: Ruby and Rails applications that render unhandled exceptions.
risk: Source layout and dependency versions disclosed to any requester; MEDIUM severity.
